entries.title: Logan Beats Himself to the Top of the World
entries.subtitle: Joe pillages his own Group F for seven points, while Sean's Turkey win the most pointless three goals in footballing history
entries.html:
If Wednesday belonged to Geo, Thursday took it back at knifepoint. A night of brothers-in-arms beating one another senseless, of qualification confirmed and dreams quietly euthanised, and of one man arriving second and leaving as the undisputed monarch of the £60 pot — by the deeply unsporting method of beating his own team.

Group E — Logan stages a one-man civil war

Behold the fixture for the existentialists: 🇪🇨 Ecuador 2-1 🇩🇪 Germany, Logan versus Logan, a man who could neither win nor lose and somehow managed both. Germany top the group regardless, qualified and serene; Ecuador snatch the win yet slither into third, sweating on the best-third lottery like a gambler refreshing his phone. Elsewhere 🇨🇮 Ivory Coast strolled past Barney's 🇨🇼 Curaçao 2-0 — Joe's side qualifying second AND seizing the top of League 4 from Barney's Canada in the process — while Curaçao, with one goal scored and nine conceded, trudge out the door apologising to the cleaning staff.

Group F — the House of Joe eats itself

Joe, who owns three-quarters of this group, spent the night both feasting and self-harming. 🇳🇱 Netherlands battered his own 🇹🇳 Tunisia 3-1 to finish top on seven, the Dutch now sitting pretty in League 1 — but poor Tunisia became the night's wooden-spooners, played three, lost three, twelve goals conceded, the proud heir to the calamity Pete's Haiti pioneered yesterday. Meanwhile 🇯🇵 Japan 1-1 🇸🇪 Sweden saw Logan's Japan qualify second while Joe's Sweden are left third, gnawing knuckles in the lottery. Joe still trousered a glorious SEVEN points — his fattest haul since the opening week and the engine of a genuine surge up the form charts.

Group D — heroics that helped nobody

🇵🇾 Paraguay 0-0 🇦🇺 Australia handed Geo a single, threadbare point and second place for the Socceroos; Barney's Paraguay cling on in third. Then came Sean's masterpiece of futility: 🇹🇷 Turkey 3-2 🇺🇸 United States, a thumping win that did precisely nothing — the USA topped the group anyway, qualifying for Pete, while Turkey are eliminated. Three goals, three points for Sean, and a team going home. Pete, for his part, banked a flat zero yet still saw his Americans win the group — proof the man can lose even when his team wins.

The Reckoning

And so the crown changes heads. Logan added four, drew level with Geo on 36, and by the tie-break inherits the summit of the £60 player league — overtaking the very man who was anointed king barely 24 hours ago. Geo, a measly +1 from Australia's bore draw, slips to second, still emperor of Leagues 1, 2, 3 and 6 but suddenly mortal. Joe's seven-point raid vaults him to 27, level with Barney and clutching the new lead in League 4. Sean won three goals and won nothing that matters, nudging to 22. And Pete? Still rooted to the foot of the table on 16, scoreless on the night, the only man whose team qualified yet whose evening still tasted of ash. On the night: Joe and Logan plundered. In the tables: Logan reigns — for now.

entries.title: Geo Conquers, Qatar Crumbles, and Pete Plumbs the Haitian Depths
entries.subtitle: A night the Thomas TwoShell empire ate itself in Group A — and still came out smelling of roses
entries.html:
Lo, on the Night of Wednesday 24 June the heavens opened and rained nine sweepstake points upon the chosen, while the wretched were left to gnash their teeth in the away end — and nobody, but nobody, gnashed harder than Pete.

Group B — Switzerland take it, Geo eats himself again

🇨🇭 Switzerland did exactly what Switzerland do, settling 🇨🇦 Canada 2-1 with the cold efficiency of a numbered bank account, topping the group on seven and handing Geo a tidy haul. Spare a thought, then, for Barney, whose Canada still squeak through in second yet contributed the grand sum of sod all to his evening. Meanwhile 🇧🇦 Bosnia-Herzegovina battered 🇶🇦 Qatar 3-1 — Logan's underdogs feasting on Geo's other lamb. Qatar, with two goals for and TEN against, depart the tournament looking like they wandered into the wrong stadium and apologised the whole way through.

Group C — Brazil purr, Scotland perish, Pete's Haitian horror

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 Scotland were taken behind the bike sheds by 🇧🇷 Brazil, 0-3, and Sean's Tartan Army now sit third, biting their nails through the best-third lottery like a man waiting on a hospital scan. Brazil cruise. And in the night's true bloodbath, 🇲🇦 Morocco put four past 🇭🇹 Haiti, Logan banking yet more while Pete's Haiti slunk off with played three, lost three, nil points — a campaign of such unrelenting calamity it deserves its own Netflix documentary and a grief counsellor.

Group A — the house of Thomas TwoShell devours its own

Here, dear watcher, was farce of the highest order. 🇲🇽 Mexico dismantled Logan's 🇨🇿 Czechia 0-3 to finish a flawless nine points, knocking Germany off the summit of League 1 in the process. Then came the fixture for the philosophers: 🇿🇦 South Africa 1-0 🇰🇷 South Korea — Geo versus Geo, a man arm-wrestling himself in the mirror and somehow losing one hand. South Africa qualify second, South Korea wobble into third, and Geo simply shrugged, having owned every single boot on the pitch.

The Reckoning

And so to the ledger. Geo banked NINE points, vaulting from second to top of the £60 player league on 35, and now leads Leagues 1, 2 and 3 through Mexico and Switzerland — an emperor surveying his realm even as Qatar and South Korea bleed out at his feet. Logan matched him point for point, also +9, climbing third to second on 32 and crowning Bosnia atop League 7. The cruellest twist belongs to Barney, who walked in leading the whole thing and walked out third, undone not by his own teams but by the sheer relentlessness of the two men above him. Joe (a stationary fourth) and Sean (fifth) merely watched. And Pete? Pete props up the table on 16, the proud owner of the only side on the planet to lose all three, a man whose World Cup is now purely spectatorial. On the night: Geo and Logan feasted. In the tables: Geo is king. Long may he reign — until tomorrow, when football, as ever, comes for everybody.
